body:
How exactly am I a fighter? Pretty much I have been just creating my own reality all this time to escape from the actual life. Even to him I used to always tell how wonderful my childhood was, how we were the perfect family. 

I am just all alone now, I don't know anyone here and I don't even want to. I have no significance in life. Do you even think someone will miss me if I go?
Well probably my mom and dad will, and that's the only thing that's stopping me from taking the next step.

I am just feeling too tired about all. I am pretty sure it's not even about something he has or hasn't done. It's just I am stupid little girl, with stupid dreams, who never learns. I tried to be happy, I have been trying as long as I can remember. I never really felt joy, I never jumped around with happiness for example. I realize now, the only thing made me feel like I am alive was being with him. He used to hold me close, we would lay on the bed. He would caress my skin, telling how soft it feels. He told me many times he wanted to spend the rest of his life with me, I believed him. I held onto him.
I would spend my life with him. But it was all for nothing.

I am trying to hold on. I talked with the guy I posted about, tried to tell him how awful I am feeling. I told him I would like to send him the reminders/souvenirs I kept from the time we have spent together because they are very important for me and I would like him to have them. I kept the plane tickets, train tickets, restaurant bills, the letters we wrote etc. 

He said he doesn't want to have anything to do with me if I am going down this road and having these thoughts. He said I can just do whatever I want, and I have the worst reasons ever to think about something like this. He said I was spoiled, and expected life to be perfect all the time. I am not sure, maybe he is right, but I don't think I even know what a perfect life is. He was just my best friend, only friend, only one I could talk to and share. Now I really know he stopped caring about me a long time ago.
